author: VOfficial404

description.en: Ollama with a model of its library, as an OpenAI-compatible API at 127.0.0.1:11434/v1 that the in-app chat uses.
description.zh-Hans: 用 Ollama 运行其模型库中的模型，在 127.0.0.1:11434/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容 API，应用内聊天可直接使用。
description.zh-Hant: 用 Ollama 執行其模型庫中的模型，在 127.0.0.1:11434/v1 提供 OpenAI 相容 API，應用程式內聊天可直接使用。

help.en: A name of ollama.com/library, as qwen3:8b or gemma3:12b.

script:
# Ollama on the runtime: an OpenAI-compatible API at 127.0.0.1:11434/v1.
set -euo pipefail
PULL=
( while true; do touch "$COLAUNCH_BUSY"; sleep 30; done ) &
BUSY=$!
trap 'kill "$BUSY" $PULL 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

echo "@@PHASE install@@"
if ! command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # The official installer unpacks a .tar.zst.
  if ! command -v zstd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -qq
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq zstd >/dev/null
  fi
  curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
fi

echo "@@PHASE download@@"
# A server of its own, on another port, pulls the model, so that the
# ready check passes only once the real one serves it.
OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11435 ollama serve >/dev/null 2>&1 &
PULL=$!
for _ in $(seq 60); do
  curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:11435/api/version && break
  sleep 1
done
OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11435 ollama pull "$COLAUNCH_MODEL"
kill "$PULL"
wait "$PULL" 2>/dev/null || true

kill "$BUSY" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT
export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434
export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE="${COLAUNCH_KEEP_ALIVE:-30m}"
if [ -n "${COLAUNCH_CONTEXT:-}" ] && [ "$COLAUNCH_CONTEXT" != 0 ]; then
  export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH="$COLAUNCH_CONTEXT"
fi
echo "@@PHASE start@@"
exec ollama serve
readme:
# Ollama

Installs Ollama with its official installer (https://ollama.com/install.sh, which needs zstd: the script installs it with apt), pulls the model of the field, and serves it on 127.0.0.1:11434. `/v1` is an OpenAI-compatible API: the in-app chat sends the model's name.
